findings.claim: resetJointState updates multibody joint q, forward kinematics, collider world transforms and AABBs without performing collision dispatch.
getContactPoints reports dispatcher persistent manifolds. The response buffer is distinct from the persistent manifold cache.
A persistent point may survive at positive distance up to its contact breaking threshold. Resetting q or repeating collision detection is not a proof of an empty manifold cache.
Fresh getClosestPoints uses contactPairTest and current collision-object world transforms; it does not dispatch the persistent broadphase collision pair.
contactPairTest passes sharedManifold=0 and BT_CLOSEST_POINT_ALGORITHMS, then destructs and frees the query algorithm.
The convex closest-query algorithm may temporarily own a newly allocated manifold. Its destructor releases that manifold; saying no manifold is ever created would be inaccurate.
The compound child path uses temporary closest algorithms when the distance threshold is positive and frees them. Compound-compound uses the same temporary allocation/release pattern.

In this synchronous single-client path, resetting the reference pose and using only fresh positive-distance closest queries avoids storing reference overclosure as persistent manifolds for the proxy channel. Restore the proxy pose before collision dispatch.

Only querying proxy-state persistent manifolds preserves the strict proxy nonpad rule without creating reference-side historical contact artifacts. It does not prove the proxy is dynamically reachable.

No physical experiment or cache probe was run. The claim is source-backed operation ordering, not a new engine performance result. Existing proxy-origin persistent contacts remain subject to the original hard gates.
The 0.02 m global source initializer is not asserted as an actual per-manifold runtime threshold. No threshold is changed.
A move to home is not used. DBVT incremental pair cleanup and manifold refresh mean one home collision-detection call is not a proven universal cache-clear operation.

reference_after_legal_entry: reset robot registered joints to frozen reference
fresh getClosestPoints with positive query radius
proxy: reset same robot joints to frozen contact-feasible proxy
record full getContactPoints and fresh closest
apply all original strict proxy gates
adopted_protocol.root_queries: Root localization must likewise avoid creating persistent contacts from diagnostic overlap snapshots; fresh closest reports geometry, not force.
prohibited_changes: no relaxation of proxy or future dynamic gates
